notes: No argument emits the exact C actor line; the social's absent room line emits no invented audience bytes.
A sleeping target below POS_RESTING receives only the C proper-position refusal.
A missing visible target uses the exact C not-found string.
Self-target uses the C self-target line; the social's absent room line emits no invented audience bytes.
A standing visible target receives the actor, room observer, and victim trio with C hide behavior.
PLR_NOSHOUT blocks the social before target lookup or audience emission with C's emote refusal.
